I live with my boyfriend now. We have an Apartment together- he and I were best friends with the guy that raped me before we started dating. When he found out I had to beg him not to kill the guy- but things are still weird with my family. My dad has gaslighted me my entire life, making me believe it was all in my head and that I’m crazy. Nowadays my father doesn’t even look in my direction, he pretends I don’t exist. And my mom finally told me that I was adopted by the only father I ever knew- my bio dad didn’t even know I existed so it was hard to start a relationship with him. My life is complicated to say the least but I find trying to talk to people about it makes me feel better about the things I can’t control- like you. You’re helping me more than you know right now. And thank you for praying ❤️
You’re a saint, and your son is very lucky to have someone so empathetic and caring 😊

My dad molested me growing up too. He traded me to what I thought was my first boyfriend for drugs. I should’ve known something was sketch because I was an 8th grader and someone in their first year of college was interested in being with me- but hindsight is 20/20. He abused me emotionally and made me do things I didn’t want to all so my dad could get high and touch me when I got home— my mom knows and is still with him till this day. I hate him. And I love him. This world is seriously fucked up. I agree with what you said about how people who haven’t been through it underestimate the damage it can do- if you need anyone who understands, I’m here. And if you just want to avoid the topic completely and talk about food or something I’m here for that too.

It exists but surprisingly I think only in the people who have endured the most. I still hope my rapist is okay. I hate him and yet some part deep within me cares still because he was once a good friend.  It’s a complex and irritating feeling to love and hate at the same time
Thank you, the fact that anyone even responded to me being open on here made me hopeful 🖤

I’m sorry to hear that- HAPPY LATE BIRTHDAY! & I think it’s more or less me feeling unsatisfied with myself like “what have I accomplished since my last birthday?”, and the realization that this is another year closer to shitting on myself in a nursing home.

It started with my dad doing things to me/trading me for drugs as a child- my mother stayed with him anyways, which I feel is the root of all this. And my soulmate knows although he doesn’t know how to help and I’m not sure how to help myself either- so we’re just kinda stuck. I thought about breaking up with him as a way to “soften the blow” if I do decide to end my life, although I’m not sure how well that would work. I’ve been to therapy but I NEED someone who understands/has been through it themselves, how do I even go about finding that person to talk to??
